{{short description|Login solution in Denmark}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=July 2022}}
[[File:NemIDLogo.png|thumb|right|The NemID logo often appears where its usage is required or one of the log in options]]'''NemID''' ({{literal|EasyID}}) was a common [[login]] solution for Danish [[Internet bank]]s, [[government website]]s, and some other private companies. NemID was managed by the [[:da:DanID|Nets DanID A/S]] company and came into use on July 1, 2010. During its use, everyone in Denmark who was more than 15 years old and had a [[Personal identification number (Denmark)|CPR-Number]] was eligible for a NemID, which could be used with their bank as well as public institutions. Anyone over 13 years old was able to use a NemID for internet banking. NemID was scheduled to be phased out on 30 June 2023,<ref>{{cite web|title=NemID will close soon|url=https://www.nemid.nu/dk-en/about_nemid/nemid_will_soon_close.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230325144611/https://www.nemid.nu/dk-en/about_nemid/nemid_will_soon_close.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=25 March 2023|website=NemID|language=en}}</ref> and replaced by [[MitID]]. It was shut down on 31 October 2023.<ref>{{cite web|title=NemID|url=https://www.borger.dk/hjaelp-og-vejledning/hvad-har-du-brug-for-hjaelp-til/NemID|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240106185510/https://www.borger.dk/hjaelp-og-vejledning/hvad-har-du-brug-for-hjaelp-til/NemID|url-status=dead|archive-date=6 January 2024|access-date=6 January 2024|website=www.borger.dk|publisher=Digitaliseringsstyrelsen|language=da}}</ref>

== Operation ==
[[File:NemID card Pic00082.jpg|thumb|right|A NemID card that holds the user's private one-time-use keys]]Users of NemID were assigned a unique ID number that could be used as a username in addition to their [[Personal identification number (Denmark)|CPR-Number]] or a user-defined username.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Under 18 - NemID|url=https://www.nemid.nu/dk-en/about_nemid/under_18/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200227125240/https://www.nemid.nu/dk-en/about_nemid/under_18/|url-status=dead|archive-date=27 February 2020|access-date=2023-09-13|website=NemID|language=da}}</ref> They would receive a card containing pairs of numbers, similar to [[Transaction authentication number]]s. After logging in with a username and password, NemID users were prompted to enter a key corresponding to a number as part of NemID's [[two-factor authentication]] scheme. These private keys were [[One-time password|one-time use]] only. After all of them were used the user was required to get new private keys, which were typically sent to the user via mail once they were about to run out.

Private keys were kept in a central server.{{citation needed|date=August 2012}} This has caused criticism against the security of NemID system.{{citation needed|date=August 2012}}[[File:NemidNøgleviser.jpg|thumbnail|A NemID code token.]]

Unlike other web-based [[single sign-on]] solutions, NemID was not based on a [[cryptography|cryptographical]] guarantee. While the security of Google's single sign-on, for example, is based on [[HTTPS]], in that you use the domain name accounts.google.com in the browser's address line to ensure that you only send your password to Google ([[trusted third party]]), NemID was based on inputting your NemID-password on arbitrary webpages which show something that looks like a NemID password dialog, and then hoping that these pages do not steal your NemID-password.<ref name="thue">{{Cite web|last=Kristensen|first=Thue|date=4 January 2016|title=NemID er ikke kryptologisk sikker - og myndighederne er ligeglade|url=http://www.version2.dk/blog/nemid-er-ikke-kryptologisk-sikker-og-myndighederne-er-ligeglade-513303|website=[[Ingeniøren]]|language=da}}</ref> As NemID was a legally binding signature which gave access to bank accounts and protected much personal information, this lack of cryptographical security has been criticized.<ref name="thue" /><ref>{{Cite web|last=Biering|first=Henrik|date=17 September 2013|title=Myter om NemID|url=http://www.version2.dk/blog/myter-om-nemid-54059|website=[[Ingeniøren]]|language=da}}</ref> There appear to be no concrete reason for NemID to not have been designed with a cryptographical guarantee.<ref name="thue" />

== History ==
On 11 April 2013, the NemID system shut itself down in response to a [[Denial-of-service attack|DDoS attack]], causing widespread chaos in Denmark where internet banking was not possible during the attack.<ref name="nemidDdos">{{cite web|title=UPDATE: NemID system running again following attack|url=http://cphpost.dk/national/nemid-system-attack|archive-url=https://archive.today/20130701041738/http://cphpost.dk/national/nemid-system-attack|url-status=dead|archive-date=1 July 2013|accessdate=12 April 2013|website=[[Copenhagen Post]]}}</ref> With Java version 1.7.0_45, NemID Java applet was not able to log users in.<ref>{{Cite news|date=16 October 2013|title=NemID dur ikke med seneste opdatering|url=http://www.b.dk/tech/nemid-dur-ikke-med-seneste-opdatering|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131018051044/http://www.b.dk/tech/nemid-dur-ikke-med-seneste-opdatering|url-status=dead|archive-date=18 October 2013|website=[[Berlingske]]|language=da}}</ref>

On 29 May 2018, [[Digitaliseringsstyrelsen]] and [[Finans Danmark]] launched the NemID key app for smartphones, as a supplement to the NemID cards and NemID code tokens.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Carlsen|first=Jacob|date=28 May 2018|title=Nu kan du lade nøglekortet ligge - NemID er blevet til en app|url=http://nyheder.tv2.dk/penge/2018-05-28-nu-kan-du-lade-noeglekortet-ligge-nemid-er-blevet-til-en-app|website=[[TV 2 (Danish TV channel)|TV 2]]|language=da}}</ref>

[[MitID]] was rolled out as a replacement for NemID between 2021 and 2022.<ref>{{Cite web|date=6 October 2021|title=MitID vil løbende erstatte NemID|url=https://www.nemid.nu/dk-da/om-nemid/aktuelt//MitID_vil_lobende_erstatte_NemID.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211022053037/https://www.nemid.nu/dk-da/om-nemid/aktuelt/MitID_vil_lobende_erstatte_NemID.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=22 October 2021|website=NemID|language=da}}</ref> In November 2022, it was announced that NemID would end on 30 June 2023.<ref>{{Cite web|date=1 September 2022|title=Om NemID og MitID efter d. 31. oktober|url=https://www.mitid.dk/om-mitid/nyheder/om-nemid-og-mitid-efter-d-31-oktober/|website=MitID|language=da}}</ref> It was shut down on 31 October 2023.
